description:
Rate a fragrance from 1 to 10 on Noteboxd (1 = Unwearable, 5 = Average, 8 = Excellent, 10 = Masterpiece). Creates a score-only review, or changes the score on your existing review without touching its text. Free for any signed-in account. Confirm the fragrance and score with the user before calling.

See also: `user_review_upsert` to write or edit review text · `user_get_reviews` to see your reviews.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

name: user_rate_fragrance
